answer.explanation: Within 01:46:56-01:56:56Z, every ThumbnailerFunction invocation ran at @memorySize 128000000 bytes. Its history shows 1024 MB for most hours, so the memory setting was dropped to 128 MB. After the change, average duration rose from about 111-115 ms to about 435-520 ms, and cold-start Init Duration was roughly 430-550 ms. Peak memory used was about 101-106 MB, close to the 128 MB ceiling. The logs contain no explicit errors, timeouts or AccessDenied lines for any of the four functions, and the other functions (CrudApi, Uploader, Compression) show no memory change. The IAM layer was not implicated. I had no tool to read the IaC template or the function's change history, so I could not confirm whether the change was made in the template or only on the live function. The candidate is therefore the live MemorySize parameter.
